
# Identifier

An identifier held by a user for transaction reporting obligations, such as a national ID or passport number. The applicable identifier standard depends on the issuing country's priority rules.

## Structure

`Identifier`

## Fields

| Name | Type | Tags | Description |
|  --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Id` | `Guid` | Required | Unique identifier of the user identifier resource, as a UUID. |
| `CreatedAt` | `DateTime` | Required | Date and time when the resource was created. [RFC 3339-5](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3339#section-5.6), [ISO8601 UTC](https://www.iso.org/iso-8601-date-and-time-format.html) |
| `UpdatedAt` | `DateTime` | Required | Date and time when the resource was last updated. [RFC 3339-5](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3339#section-5.6), [ISO8601 UTC](https://www.iso.org/iso-8601-date-and-time-format.html) |
| `UserId` | `Guid` | Required | Unique identifier of the user, as a UUID. |
| `IdentifierStandard` | `string` | Required | Identifier standard abbreviation. If it is not provided, the issuing country's 1st priority identifier standard is used by default. Use `CONCAT` to submit a CONCAT identifier. See the User identifiers guide ([TOL](https://docs.upvest.co/products/tol/guides/users/users_identifiers) / [BYOL](https://docs.upvest.co/products/byol/guides/users/users_identifiers)).<br><br>**Constraints**: *Maximum Length*: `6` |
| `Identifier` | `string` | Required | Identifier value. Omit this field when `identifier_standard` is `CONCAT`: the value is generated by Upvest from the user's name and date of birth. See the User identifiers guide ([TOL](https://docs.upvest.co/products/tol/guides/users/users_identifiers) / [BYOL](https://docs.upvest.co/products/byol/guides/users/users_identifiers)).<br><br>**Constraints**: *Minimum Length*: `0`, *Maximum Length*: `30` |
| `Type` | [`Type7`](../../doc/models/type-7.md) | Required | Identifier type.<br><br>* NATIONAL_ID — national identity card number issued by the user's country.<br>* PASSPORT — passport number issued by the user's country.<br><br>**Default**: `Type7.NATIONAL_ID` |
| `IssuingCountry` | [`IssuingCountry`](../../doc/models/issuing-country.md) | Required | Accepted country code. [ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2). |

## Example

```csharp
using System.Globalization;
using UpvestInvestmentApi.Standard.Models;

Identifier identifier = new Identifier
{
    Id = new Guid("0000052a-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"),
    CreatedAt = DateTime.ParseExact("2016-03-13T12:52:32.123Z", "yyyy'-'MM'-'dd'T'HH':'mm':'ss.FFFFFFFK",
        provider: CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
        DateTimeStyles.RoundtripKind),
    UpdatedAt = DateTime.ParseExact("2016-03-13T12:52:32.123Z", "yyyy'-'MM'-'dd'T'HH':'mm':'ss.FFFFFFFK",
        provider: CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
        DateTimeStyles.RoundtripKind),
    UserId = new Guid("00000c3a-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"),
    IdentifierStandard = "identifier_standard0",
    IdentifierProp = "identifier0",
    Type = Type7.NationalId,
    IssuingCountry = IssuingCountry.Gb,
};
```
